\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch2:2-19

↗ prop:hodge-star-euclidean-single ↗ prop:hodge-star-euclidean-pair Regard $\mathbb {R}^n$ as a Riemannian manifold with the Euclidean metric and the standard orientation, and let $*$ denote the Hodge star operator defined in Problem 2-18.

(a) Calculate $* dx^i$ for $i = 1, \ldots , n$.

(b) Calculate $*(dx^i \wedge dx^j)$ in the case $n = 4$. \end{exercise}
